name: Shield Corridor
body:
Prerequisite(s): Magus 3, Shield proficiency, Arcane Shield Defense

Benefit(s): When a magus uses the Arcane Shield Defense arcana to successfully save against an area of effect spell, she also blocks line of effect in a 10 foot corridor. Any allies within this area are not affected by the spell.
